method: All session JSONL entries parsed; text, thinking and tool arguments indexed locally, binary image/audio bodies excluded. All local git refs: commit metadata and bodies, with selected diffs inspected. All available bd issue snapshots including closed; comments fetched for all 88 issue IDs with positive comment_count. Global and checkout-local whisper Markdown plus checkout-local wai Markdown parsed. Directed reading of relevant conversations and artifact passages.
limits: Live files can grow during the scan; this is a per-file observational snapshot, not an atomic frozen archive.
Git worktrees repeat commits; counts are deduplicated globally by SHA only for the unique total.
Tickets repeat across worktrees; unique total is deduplicated by issue ID, not an assertion that every repeated snapshot is identical.
Earliest reachable author date is not repository creation date, conception date or merge date.
Pi records of tool construction are not evidence of recurring use on unrelated projects.
Coverage includes unrelated Pi sessions and an embedded third-party git checkout; the narrative only uses ecosystem-relevant evidence.
No January–March Pi sessions exist in this available archive; deletions and unavailable remotes are not recoverable from this scan.
